name: JxJ Joshikousei Juuka Keikaku Breeding Bull Sex Training
original_name: J×J 女子校生獣化計画 種牛性処理調教
source:
A few days after the public humiliation and training disguised as treatment began... The three are instructed to satisfy the sexual desires of bulls at a breeding cattle ranch on a remote island. Forced to repeatedly have sex with bulls, they are pushed to their physical limits, and another animal therapy scene unfolds...
